_doc: Lab PKI templates — the AD-CS-style template layer for this lab.
edy-proxy-go's signing profiles are FIXED IN CODE (user | machine |
code-signing | uefi; internal/pki/profiles.go) with no server-side
template concept, so templates live HERE: a named intent maps to a
profile plus key/subject/SAN policy, expanded by 42-tls-from-edy-ca.sh.
The issuing CA is the EDY Proxy Root CA (pathlen:0 — it signs leaves
only; a subordinate 'AD Lab Issuing CA' needs a root with pathlen>0
first, which is a controller-side change).

domain-controller.subject: /O=EDT1 Lab/CN={fqdn}
domain-controller.purpose: DC LDAPS/GC server cert: ServerAuth+ClientAuth, SANs for host FQDN, domain, and address.

member-server.subject: /O=EDT1 Lab/CN={fqdn}
member-server.purpose: Domain member service cert (e.g. xrdp TLS, web endpoints).
